review.rationale: Both plans faithfully select the gated packaged Unreal vertical slice and explicitly defer migration clearance and identity promotion. A is stronger because it separates prerequisite readiness, packaged-boundary proof, loop composition, adversarial verification, and evidence review into clearer gates; defines ownership, cost, time, integrity, diagnostic, and approval controls more completely; and maps assertions to concrete artifacts and stop conditions. B remains strong but partially conflates the dependency probe with repeatedly producing and running the packaged build, which overlaps its later implementation phase, and leaves more evidence-governance and resource-envelope details for the downstream planner to reconstruct.
